title: The risks of Ozempic – level 1
paragraphs: Ozempic is now very famous in America. First, it helps sick people, but now many people use it to look thin.

The companies spend a lot of money on big television advertisements. Normal parents and children see these advertisements every week. The videos show that thin people are always happy and big people are sad. This makes everyone want to lose weight. It makes people feel bad about their bodies. Some people even buy the medicine online without a doctor’s prescription.
Scientists say that this is dangerous. We must follow the rules of science, not television. We must speak about the risks of Ozempic, too.

words.d: a video, picture, or text on TV or the internet which makes people want to buy a product
how heavy a person or an object is
the chance of something bad happening to your health or life
